<!-- What this changes, and why. One change per pull request (CONTRIBUTING.md). -->

- [ ] A test that fails without this change
- [ ] A line in `CHANGELOG.md` under Unreleased, if a user would notice
- [ ] Nothing private: no real rule names, hostnames, incident titles or company data
- [ ] A new command, a new kind of data in the ledger, or a change to how a firing is judged has a design note in `docs/design/` first
